0022600108.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central, 7th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (1-1, 2nd in the Southeast, 5th in the East) in the Bulls' third game of the 2026-27 season, coming off a win in their last outing. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Noa Essengue is day-to-day with a head injury and is a game-time decision. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (out, ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Bulls won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026.
